subject: reasoning
question: In a college debate competition, six girl students - Savita, Kavita, Namita, Diya, Piya and Riya are divided into two equal teams to compete. Each team has equal number of members, and both the teams are sitting in two rows facing each other. Piya does not sit at any end of the row. Kavita is sitting immediately next to Riya. Diya is sitting second to the left of Riya. Namita, who is sitting immediately next to Piya, is sitting diagonally opposite to Diya. Who among the following are sitting diagonally opposite each other?
solution:
As per the given information the sitting arrangement:

1. Diya is sitting second to the left of Riya and Kavita is sitting immediately next to Riya.
